subject.title: improve: let Code Mode use declared tool result shapes

question: Should `AgentTool.outputSchema` become the supported optional plugin API for both model-visible result hints and runtime validation of `AgentToolResult.details`?
rationale: The implementation can be technically sound while committing OpenClaw to a compatibility-sensitive plugin contract and fail-closed execution semantics for opted-in tools; that permanent API direction requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the shared contract
options.body: Adopt `outputSchema` as the optional plugin API, preserve omission as the existing raw-first behavior, and require rebase plus fresh exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Keep it internal first
options.body: Limit output contracts to built-in and internal tools until the schema vocabulary, error semantics, and plugin compatibility policy are proven further.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Retain unknown raw-first outputs if maintainers do not want schema mismatches to create a new plugin-visible failure mode.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared contract
recommendation.body: Adopt `outputSchema` as the optional plugin API, preserve omission as the existing raw-first behavior, and require rebase plus fresh exact-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current and immediately preceding merged Code Mode work is concentrated in this contributor's history, making them the best available owner to frame the API decision for final maintainer approval.
